Messages.Author: Henrik Klippström
Messages.Body:
Hi all you sumprunkare! Here is a remake of my old bloodthief-deck. No
more arabs (a retarded president said they are terrorists). This time
it´s princes instead. Again, its mostly a casual play deck – not
really competative. Trouble for the deck is of course IG. And Drawing
Out the Beast. And Carrion Crows. Any replys are welcome!

Crypt:
3 Menele (To speed things up)
2 Lucas Halton (Great special ability. Prince.)
3 Fleurdumal (Sure, only tha, but otherwise nice. Prince.)
2 Javier Montoya (Prince.)
2 Anastazi Zagreb (Justicar.)
(Really powerful crypt. Although the deck only utilizes thaumaturgy,
celerity and some auspex (for Nose), all vampires in the crypt except
Fleurdumal possess dominate, all except Halton and Zagreb got presence
and all except Menele (who is a very sneaky character) holds 2 or 3
votes!)

Masters (18):
4 Information Highway
4 Celerity
2 Heidelburg Castle (To move blood and make retainers and equipment
work overtime.)
5 Blood Doll (Must have more pool, more pooooool!)
2 The Rack (Abuse with Mr Menele.)
1 Socierty of Leopold (Hahaaaa! Buuuuuurn!)

Actions and equipment (15):
8 Nose of the Hound (Some of these could be Bums Rush or Harass.)
2 IR Goggles
1 Rutors Hand
1 Judgement: Camarilla Segregation (Never leave home without it!)
1 JS Simmons Esq
1 Tasha Morgan
1 Laptop Computor
(Much to consider here. Could use Pulse, but it can´t be moved by
Heidelberg, the vamps are so fat you need to make every bleed that
gets through at least a 2. The deck could, if you find some space,
include some votes, like Parity Shift – combo with Highway.)

Combat (44):
19 Theft of Vitae
10 Pursuit
6 Blur
7 Sideslip
2 Psyche! (Depending on how much S:CE it´s in the local enviroment.)
(Not sure how much of what. Play and you guys will tell I hope.)

Reactions (13):
9 Second Tradition: The Domain (Add some static intecept and some of
these could be Wakes.)
4 Deflection

Regards,
Ashur

Messages.Author: Matthew T. Morgan
Messages.Body:

> Hi all you sumprunkare! Here is a remake of my old bloodthief-deck. No

Hah! I guess you didn't really mean that last line. Anyway, thought I'd
offer you a few thoughts so your time isn't completely wasted with this
post.

> Crypt:
> 3 Menele (To speed things up)
> 2 Lucas Halton (Great special ability. Prince.)
> 3 Fleurdumal (Sure, only tha, but otherwise nice. Prince.)
> 2 Javier Montoya (Prince.)

> and all except Menele (who is a very sneaky character) holds 2 or 3

Speaking of all those votes, how about throwing in a few Anathema? That's
the perfect card to make this "just-for-fun" deck a little more fun. Also
you might consider a Brujah Justicar for Menele so he can play the 2nd
Traditions.

> Masters (18):

Seems like too many masters for a deck like this to me. You might play
6-7 cards in a combat and end up with nothing but masters in your hand.
You should add a Dreams of the Sphinx at least.

> 4 Information Highway

Maybe Zillah's Valley would be better? 4 Infos means you get to play 1
and discard 3.

> 4 Celerity

Lucas and Menele already have the goods. I'd drop this to 2.

> 2 Heidelburg Castle (To move blood and make retainers and equipment
> work overtime.)

Useful, but is it important enough to have 2? 1 should be enough.

> 5 Blood Doll (Must have more pool, more pooooool!)
> 2 The Rack (Abuse with Mr Menele.)

Again, I'd probably only use 1.

> 1 Socierty of Leopold (Hahaaaa! Buuuuuurn!)
>
> Actions and equipment (15):
> 8 Nose of the Hound (Some of these could be Bums Rush or Harass.)

I'd probably replace 3 of them with Bum's Rush just in case there's an
untapped vamp you want to kill.

> 2 IR Goggles
> 1 Rutors Hand

Another might be a good idea. Magic of the Smith to get them or is your
"bruise & get stuff" strategy sure to scare off blockers?

> 1 Judgement: Camarilla Segregation (Never leave home without it!)
> 1 JS Simmons Esq
> 1 Tasha Morgan
> 1 Laptop Computor
> (Much to consider here. Could use Pulse, but it can´t be moved by
> Heidelberg, the vamps are so fat you need to make every bleed that
> gets through at least a 2. The deck could, if you find some space,
> include some votes, like Parity Shift – combo with Highway.)

7 of your 12 crypt slots can play Conditioning. I'd put a couple in.

> Combat (44):
> 19 Theft of Vitae
> 10 Pursuit
> 6 Blur
> 7 Sideslip
> 2 Psyche! (Depending on how much S:CE it´s in the local enviroment.)
> (Not sure how much of what. Play and you guys will tell I hope.)

I'd use a little more Psyche! for my group. Otherwise looks pretty good.
Maybe squeeze in a Walk of Flame or two for the old coup de grace?
Obviously you'd need more presses or maybe Telepathic Tracking. Some of
the Pursuits could become Flashes.

You don't have much card cycling. How about adding Infernal Pursuit?

> Reactions (13):
> 9 Second Tradition: The Domain (Add some static intecept and some of
> these could be Wakes.)
> 4 Deflection

Looks okay to me, although I played a deck last week that relied on 2nds
for defense only to be preyed upon by a Seduction/Elder Impersonation
deck. Gah.

Have a blast. I keep wanting to build a deck with Menele or Lucas Halton
or both but playing with such big vamps gives me panic attacks. :)

-Matt

Ha. I beat up one of your weenies before you ousted me!

If I wanted to comment on your deck I'd say something like this:

Your crypt is to big for a combat deck,

your combat strategy is outmoded and obsolete, especially considering
that
your crypt isn't disposable, (ie you die to to many common
combat/combat D strategies),

If you're paying for all that DOM/PRE/Votes use it for more than 4
Deflections and a Cammy Seg

you only have 5 blood dolls for pool gain so you'll be bleed out by
anyone with an ounce (0.02835 Kilograms) of bleed.

and 2 Psyche isn't going to stand up to even the most paper tiger of
S:CE.

Even with the untaps you spend to much time equipping.

Oh, and Lisette Vizquel hates you. (and all CEL/THA decks)

But I can't get past the fact that you decided to mock the politics of
another country for S+Giggles in a gaming newsgroup. There are places
for that, and this ain't one of them. While I know Kevin and I
disagree about a lot of politics in this country, we don't do it at
tournements, and quite frankly I'm glad he called you on it. Granted,
Euro-bullshit is a bit strong, considering 18 european contries seem
to remember that collective security = good, and appeasment = bad, so
we'll see if Kevin corrects his broad general statement of
Euro-bullshit, I expect that he will, if anyone bothers to look at
this stupid thread again.

Cameron Domer
